name: Original Invoice Information 1
definition: General information about the invoice contained in the original request.

TotalInvoiceAmount.name: Total Invoice Amount
TotalInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the invoice, being the sum of total invoice lines amounts, total invoice additional amounts (allowances and charges) and total tax amounts.

PaymentDueDate.name: Payment Due Date
PaymentDueDate.definition: Due date for the payment of the invoice.
